finding.claim: test_openviking_plugin_is_copied_in_pinned checks that the ARG line holds the SHA, and separately that the destination path and examples/hermes-plugin appear somewhere. It still passes if the curl URL fetches a branch such as main instead of the ARG, which is the "plugin is unpinned" case in r1's fails_when.

fixes.change: the test also requires the codeload URL and the tar member path to use OPENVIKING_PLUGIN_SHA; pointing the download at main now fails it.
